import subprocess, sys

# Test 1: No args → SystemExit
r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-m", "semver"], capture_output=True, text=True)
print("R1: no args exit:", r.returncode, "(expect non-zero)")

# Test 2: bump without specific args → help + graceful exit
r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-m", "semver", "bump"], capture_output=True, text=True)
print("R1: bump no args exit:", r.returncode, "(expect 0)")
print("  has help:", "--help" in r.stdout)

# Test 3: check valid
r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-m", "semver", "check", "1.0.0"], capture_output=True, text=True)
print("R3: check valid exit:", r.returncode, "(expect 0)", "|", repr(r.stdout.strip()))

# Test 4: check invalid
r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-m", "semver", "check", "invalid"], capture_output=True, text=True)
print("R3: check invalid exit:", r.returncode, "(expect non-zero)", "|", repr(r.stdout.strip()))

# Test 5: compare works
r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-m", "semver", "compare", "1.0.0", "2.0.0"], capture_output=True, text=True)
print("R4: compare exit:", r.returncode, "|", repr(r.stdout.strip()))

# Test 6: bump patch
r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-m", "semver", "bump", "patch", "1.0.0"], capture_output=True, text=True)
print("R4: bump patch:", repr(r.stdout.strip()), "(expect 1.0.1)")
